newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Taiwan share prices closed lower on Saturday as investors took profits following recent sharp gains, brokers said.
The weighted index closed Saturday's shortened session 35.73 points or 0.49 percent lower at 7,212.28.
Brokers said sentiment also was affected by recent tumbles on Wall Street.
The Dow Jones industrial average fell 59.27 points on Friday to record its first losing week in 1997.
"The fall on Wall Street dampened sentiment in Taiwan somewhat, although the market was already lacking immediate upward drive," said Michael Hung, senior analyst at Nikko Securities.

Before Saturday Taiwan's market had gained more than 400 points in January on the island's improved economic outlook. But brokers said the index's inability to sustain its latest gain on Friday may settle the market into a consolidation.
Saturday's falls were spread across the board, with textiles dropping 1.80 percent and the food sector losing 1.67 percent.
Ace Foods and Sinkong Spinning both plummeted by the daily seven-percent limit, falling T$2.80 and T$5, respectively, to close at T$37.40 and T$68.50.
Brokers expected the recent hectic trading to cool somewhat on Monday and the index to fluctuate in a narrow range from 7,170-7,250.
